mapper.select: SELECT i.*, sl.layer_name, p.shelf_layer_code AS current_layer_code, p.maintenance_status, CASE WHEN br.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'BORROWED' ELSE NULL END AS borrow_status FROM pad_inventory_item i LEFT JOIN shelf_layer sl ON i.layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_info p ON i.pad_id = p.id LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE i.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'LEDGER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.layer_code ASC, i.pad_code ASC, i.id ASC
